abs_braking_distance.definition: The distance the car travels from the moment the driver touches the brake to the moment the car stops.
abs_braking_distance.example: On a wet road the braking distance is longer than on a dry road.

blanket.definition: A thick warm cloth that covers you on cold nights.
blanket.example: I pull the blanket up to my chin.

breakfast.definition: The first meal of the day, eaten after you wake up.
breakfast.example: Breakfast is ready, so please sit down.

gem_affective_empathy.definition: The feeling part of empathy: catching what the other person feels.
gem_affective_empathy.example: Affective empathy made her notice that the new engineer was frightened in the group.

mt_cohabitation.definition: Living together as a couple without being married.
mt_cohabitation.example: Cohabitation moved their date, because the shared life came before the legal form.

spec_second_opinion.definition: The judgement of a second person, asked because the first one may not see everything.
spec_second_opinion.example: Before we sign, I would like a second opinion from somebody outside this field.
